label: 🏝️ Puerto Rico
description: Choose roles to develop your island, produce goods, and ship them for victory points. Every role helps your rivals too, so timing matters as much as building a strong economy. This adaptation of Puerto Rico 1897: Special Edition includes all six expansions and solo play against two Puertomas.
credits:
**Game designer:** Andreas Seyfarth.

**Publishers:** [Awaken Realms](https://awakenrealms.com/games/awaken-realms/puerto-rico) and [alea / Ravensburger](https://www.ravensburger.com/).

**Achievements and Festival Activities:** Andreas Seyfarth and Tomasz Zawadzki.

**Solo design:** John Albertson, Xavi Bordes, David Digby, Nick Shaw, and Dávid Turczi.

chapters.title: Roles, production and trade
chapters.description: Choose a role, produce goods and sell them. See how unchosen roles gain coins.

chapters.title: Shipping and storage
chapters.description: Load matching ships, earn points and keep only what your storage allows.

chapters.title: Workers and citizens
chapters.description: Place citizens where their special building effects matter.

chapters.title: Free the coffee supply
chapters.description: Solve a coffee shortage using the Smuggler and a Festival objective.
